QuestInfo.name: Excavated: Clean Comb
QuestInfo.0: You found one of Spiegelmann's lost tools while you were looking for artifacts.
QuestInfo.1: Bring this back to Spiegelmann. He'll probably be excited!
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann was REALLY happy to see that comb again... a little TOO happy.

0.0: Boy am I in a pickle... you might call it a bristly pickle! Wait, no, that sounds gross. How am I going to tame this stache?

no.0: You expect me to just use my hands to align these whiskers?!

1.0: M-my comb! My beloved comb! My dearest tamer of fly-aways, separator of tangles! The world has meant nothing without you! Oh, mwah, mwah, mwah! I hope you weren't scared. I kept your room just like you like it...
